requirements.statement: A task reaches done only after the integrated delivery and acceptance commit pass the complete GitHub Actions workflow and the protected integration branch advances to the verified acceptance commit.
acceptance_criteria: The harness stages each candidate SHA on an ephemeral CI branch and waits for the complete CI workflow to succeed before advancing harness.
Acceptance records bind the integrated delivery SHA to a GitHub Actions run URL rather than local-only evidence.
Failed or missing remote CI leaves the task integrated and the protected harness branch unchanged.
GitHub branch protection rejects force pushes, deletion, and commits without every required CI check.
